scope: v1 core + v2 breadth/oversold alerts and audio edition + v3 policy section and mortgage rate + v4 Owen's Alphabet Soup (daily grounded lesson, client-owned pointer) + v5 spoken rates readout (10-year, 30-year mortgage, VIX, each with its why), the Monday policy digest, cross-bucket audio dedupe, and self-healing lesson audio
note: Project docs/ is the GitHub Pages web root (PWA), not documentation. Dev docs live in documentation/.

docs.title: Architecture
docs.summary: System overview, data flow, modules, key design decisions (incl. the four monitors, the policy-section accuracy guarantees, the no-year static policy calendar, and why the Alphabet Soup lesson pointer is client-side), briefing.json and lessons.json schemas, CLI entry points.

docs.title: Integrations
docs.summary: External services (Yahoo Finance, Gemini, ntfy, RSS, Federal Register, Utah Legislature, Freddie Mac PMMS, the Wikipedia action API behind Owen's Alphabet Soup, GitHub Pages/Actions, v2 Twelve Data), usage, invocation sites, per-build request budgets, env var names, the probed-dead source list, and the static POLICY_CALENDAR that stands in for the annual announcements no feed publishes.

docs.title: Operations
docs.summary: Scheduling and DST, one-time deployment (secret/var name mapping), runtime, monitoring (4 alarms), run-state keys and their writers (and why the lesson pointer is deliberately not one), failure modes and recovery, regression tests, cost.
